lvnet:
vi SimpleReadWrite.vi :
  uses :
    subVI   Create_Tag.vi      ; ./Create_Tag.vi
    subVI   Destroy_Tag.vi     ; ./Destroy_Tag.vi
    subVI   Error_Info.vi      ; ./Error_Info.vi
    subVI   Lock.vi            ; ./Lock.vi
    typedef PLC_Attributes.ctl ; ./PLC_Attributes.ctl
    subVI   Read_Float.vi      ; ./Read_Float.vi
    subVI   Read_Tag.vi        ; ./Read_Tag.vi
    subVI   Set_Float.vi       ; ./Set_Float.vi
    subVI   Tag_Status.vi      ; ./Tag_Status.vi
    subVI   Unlock.vi          ; ./Unlock.vi
    subVI   Write_Tag.vi       ; ./Write_Tag.vi
  front-panel :
    pattern : 4815
    in   PLC Attributes          : PLC_Attributes
    in   new value to write      : SGL
    out  original tag value read : SGL
    out  new tag value read      : SGL
    out  Error Codes             : String
  block-diagram :
    constant timeout_2413 : I32 = 1000
    subVI Create_Tag_682 : Create_Tag.vi
      in   PLC Attributes      : PLC_Attributes = PLC Attributes
      in   timeout             : I32            = timeout_2413
      in   error in (no error) : Error          default
      out  "handle "           : I32
      out  error code          : I32
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Error_Info_1280 : Error_Info.vi
      in   " tag handle"       : I32    = Create_Tag_682::handle 
      in   errorcode           : I32    = Create_Tag_682::error code
      in   error in (no error) : Error  = Create_Tag_682::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error description   : String
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Tag_Status_711 : Tag_Status.vi
      in   tag handle          : I32   = Error_Info_1280::tag handle out
      in   error in (no error) : Error = Error_Info_1280::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error code          : I32
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Error_Info_434 : Error_Info.vi
      in   " tag handle"       : I32    = Tag_Status_711::tag handle out
      in   errorcode           : I32    = Tag_Status_711::error code
      in   error in (no error) : Error  = Tag_Status_711::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error description   : String
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Read_Tag_1482 : Read_Tag.vi
      in   tag handle          : I32   = Error_Info_434::tag handle out
      in   timeout             : I32   = timeout_2413
      in   error in (no error) : Error = Error_Info_434::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error code          : I32
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Error_Info_388 : Error_Info.vi
      in   " tag handle"       : I32    = Read_Tag_1482::tag handle out
      in   errorcode           : I32    = Read_Tag_1482::error code
      in   error in (no error) : Error  = Read_Tag_1482::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error description   : String
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Read_Float_1679 : Reads.lvlib:Read_Float.vi
      in   "tag handle "       : I32   = Error_Info_388::tag handle out
      in   offset              : I32   default 0
      in   error in (no error) : Error = Error_Info_388::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  tag value           : SGL
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Set_Float_395 : Sets.lvlib:Set_Float.vi
      in   "tag handle "       : I32   = Read_Float_1679::tag handle out
      in   offset              : I32   default 0
      in   value               : SGL   = new value to write
      in   error in (no error) : Error = Read_Float_1679::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error code          : I32
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Error_Info_748 : Error_Info.vi
      in   " tag handle"       : I32    = Set_Float_395::tag handle out
      in   errorcode           : I32    = Set_Float_395::error code
      in   error in (no error) : Error  = Set_Float_395::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error description   : String
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Lock_599 : Lock.vi
      in   " tag handle"       : I32   = Error_Info_748::tag handle out
      in   error in (no error) : Error = Error_Info_748::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error code          : I32
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Write_Tag_961 : Write_Tag.vi
      in   "tag handle "       : I32   = Lock_599::tag handle out
      in   timeout             : I32   = timeout_2413
      in   error in (no error) : Error = Lock_599::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error code          : I32
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Unlock_1495 : Unlock.vi
      in   " tag handle"       : I32   = Write_Tag_961::tag handle out
      in   error in (no error) : Error = Write_Tag_961::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error code          : I32
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Error_Info_144 : Error_Info.vi
      in   " tag handle"       : I32    = Unlock_1495::tag handle out
      in   errorcode           : I32    default 0
      in   error in (no error) : Error  = Unlock_1495::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error description   : String
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Read_Float_351 : Reads.lvlib:Read_Float.vi
      in   "tag handle "       : I32   = Error_Info_144::tag handle out
      in   offset              : I32   default 0
      in   error in (no error) : Error = Error_Info_144::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  tag value           : SGL
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Error_Info_866 : Error_Info.vi
      in   " tag handle"       : I32    = Read_Float_351::tag handle out
      in   errorcode           : I32    default 0
      in   error in (no error) : Error  = Read_Float_351::error out
      out  tag handle out      : I32
      out  error description   : String
      out  error out           : Error
    subVI Destroy_Tag_617 : Destroy_Tag.vi
      in   tag handle          : I32   = Error_Info_866::tag handle out
      in   error in (no error) : Error = Error_Info_866::error out
      out  error code          : I32
      out  error out           : Error
    function Concatenate_Strings_2548 : Concatenate Strings
      in   1  : String = Error_Info_1280::error description
      in   2  : String = "'\\r\\n'"
      in   3  : String = Error_Info_434::error description
      in   4  : String = "'\\r\\n'"
      in   5  : String = Error_Info_388::error description
      in   6  : String = "'\\r\\n'"
      in   7  : String = Error_Info_748::error description
      in   8  : String = "'\\r\\n'"
      in   9  : String = Error_Info_144::error description
      in   10 : String = "'\\r\\n'"
      in   11 : String = Error_Info_866::error description
      out  0  : String
    original tag value read = Read_Float_1679::tag value
    new tag value read = Read_Float_351::tag value
    Error Codes = Concatenate_Strings_2548::0
